d: Long, wavy honey-brown hair with side-swept bangs is tied into a voluminous ponytail. Large, round amber eyes set in a youthful, teenage face with a soft expression. The build is slender with a large bust. A white sleeveless top is paired with a red and green necktie, white long-sleeved detached sleeves with red trim, a grey armored corset, and a pleated red skirt with white borders. Accessories include a white sailor-style cap, a silver chain across the chest, and grey mechanical leg armor.
